summary: Sign-up often clears. Payment registration is where it stops.

items.task: Creating an account with email and password
items.note: Usually fine. The wall comes later.

items.task: Identity verification at sign-up on major platforms
items.note: The Bank of Korea has noted that many domestic platforms require SMS or ARS identity verification from registration, which restricts foreign use.

items.task: Registering a domestic payment method or simple pay
items.note: The step most often reached and not completed.
Global sites, foreigner-oriented shops and services using email-based authentication exist. 'No Korean number means no online shopping' is not true.
Couriers and delivery riders call a Korean number, so a contactable domestic number has value independent of verification.

source: Bank of Korea analysis of foreign access to domestic e-commerce, 2025
